core_obligations: Use that a bounded above complex of flat modules computes the derived tensor product to get exactness of the ordinary tensored sequence in the middle (proof lines 16889-16894).
Compute Tor_1 of the cokernel of the differential against an arbitrary module and conclude it vanishes (proof lines 16894-16900).
Apply the flatness criterion to conclude that the cokernel is flat (proof lines 16900-16903).
proof_roadmap: Replace the derived tensor product by the ordinary one (proof lines 16889-16894).
Compute the vanishing of Tor_1 for the cokernel (proof lines 16894-16900).
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that the cokernel of the differential of a bounded above flat complex at the lower end of its tor amplitude interval is flat, and the proof is a 15-line argument that replaces the derived tensor product by an ordinary one and then reads flatness off the resulting exactness. It uses that a bounded above complex of flat modules computes its own derived tensor product, so the segment of the complex around the degree in question is exact in the middle after tensoring with any module, and concludes that the higher Tor of the cokernel vanishes; the flatness criterion of the Algebra chapter then gives the statement. The exactness input and the Tor computation are displayed.
